verdict.rationale: The only evidence is from users: Trello's own welcome/starter board teaches new users how the product works, and one user reports it 'taught the user everything in 2 minutes.' This is old community feedback, not first-party documentation of a guided workspace-setup flow. Templates and the 'Your First Power-Up' developer tutorial are about other things and get no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a guided first-run walkthrough, explicit step-by-step workspace setup (inviting members, configuring the workspace), current hands-on corroboration, and engineer-specific onboarding guidance.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can follow a guided walkthrough to set up my workspace the first time

citations.quote: Signup was simple, and the starter board taught the user everything in 2 minutes.
They want the welcome board to include a card describing what voting is for.
